extraction.Name: William Bordeaux, Jr.
extraction.Refused/Protested: I told Supt. Covey that I did not want the patent but he said it had been issued and I would have to take it.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I mortgaged the land and then gave a quit claim deed for it.
extraction.Buyer: Mr. Rusho (quit claim deed recipient); mortgaged for $1000.00
extraction.Occupation/Income: I am employed by St. Francis Mission.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent was for 80 acres. Allottee states he was not defrauded by the mortgagee or Mr. Rusho. Did not ask for the patent. Has six children. Document sworn before Jes. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 29, 1929. Signed with what appears to be a native language or shorthand signature alongside printed name.
